description: Averages spectral energy over N adjacent analysis channels within each window, broadening and defocusing energy peaks. A frequency-domain blur (in effect a kind of filtering) — the counterpart of blur blur's time-domain smear, which averages across windows instead. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Enriches and roughens timbre without altering pitch content: high-energy data leaks into neighbouring channels, defocusing spectral peaks and reducing frequency definition. Small N adds grit and subtle roughening; large N smears formant detail toward a hazy, filtered character — but the roughening stops short of outright distortion, so the source stays recognisable. A time-varying N (breakpoint file) can move a sound gradually from focused to diffuse across its length.

n.description: Number of adjacent channels to average over (banner calls it N; the manual, Average-span). The banner asks for an odd value no greater than half the analysis-point count, but CDP r8 accepts even and larger values without complaint — treat that rule as advisory. Accepts a breakpoint file for time-varying averaging.

examples.expected_use: Roughen and enrich a pitched source's timbre while keeping its pitch and duration intact.

known_issues: Banner-vs-behavior divergence: the banner demands N be ODD and <= half the analysis -c/points value (the HTML manual omits the odd rule), but CDP r8 accepts even N (probed with 8) and N above the claimed limit (probed with 513 on a 1024-point analysis) with exit 0. Presumably normalised internally; the constraint is not enforced.
